RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 20

An all-female panel is not evidence of bias. Selection panels usually reflect departmental availability and leadership roles, not an intent to favor a specific gender. 

Broadcasters today heavily prioritize digital transformation. The successful candidate’s eight years of experience, combined with strong digital media skills and interview performance, likely matched the station's forward-looking strategy better than traditional seniority. 

Alleging sex discrimination based purely on the panel's demographics and the outcome is legally unfounded and would severely damage your professional reputation. Instead, send a polite follow-up regarding your written feedback request, focusing entirely on understanding the specific competencies and strategic criteria the panel prioritized.
